# Copy this whole folder to blog/your-post-slug/ to start a new post.
# The leading underscore makes Quarto skip this template when rendering, so it never shows up on the site or in the listing.
# Keep draft: true while you write. You will still see the post in `quarto preview` with a "Draft" banner. Set draft: false and render when it is ready, and it goes live.
title: "Your post title"
description: "One sentence that makes someone want to read it"
date: 2026-01-01              # publication date, format YYYY-MM-DD
categories: [leadership]      # the topic, one of: modelling, code, academia, productivity, reflections, leadership. It sets the post's colour (topics in blog/_metadata.yml). A TIL note adds a second tag, "today I learned" (see blog/_template-til/).
author:
  - name: Thinh Ong
    url: https://thinhong.github.io
    orcid: 0000-0001-6772-9291
# Cover (see "Blog covers" in STYLE-GUIDE.md). One SVG file per post, used in two places:
# image: /img/blog-art/cover-your-post.svg                       # the cover on the blog page, in the topic's colour group. Omit to use the topic cover, cover-topic-<topic>.svg.
# image-alt: "Describe the cover for screen readers"
# title-block-banner: "url(/img/blog-art/cover-your-post.svg)"   # the same file, shown beside the title of the post. Omit for a title with no picture.
# open-graph:                                                     # link previews cannot show an SVG: point them to a JPEG copy
#   image: /img/blog-art/cover-your-post.jpg                     # of the cover (1200 x 630). Omit both blocks to use the site default picture.
# twitter-card:
#   image: /img/blog-art/cover-your-post.jpg
citation:
  url: https://drthinhong.com/blog/your-post-slug/
draft: true
